summary: For the execution plane (controller, EDA, execution nodes), prefix podman with CONTAINER_HOST=unix://run/user/<uid>/podman/podman.sock or CONTAINERS_STORAGE_CONF=~/aap/containers/storage.conf.
questions: Why doesn't podman images show the execution environment images?
How do I see job containers on containerized AAP?
What is CONTAINER_HOST for AAP execution plane?

answer_card.title: Inspect the execution plane
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
CONTAINER_HOST=unix://run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock podman images
# or
CONTAINERS_STORAGE_CONF=~/aap/containers/storage.conf podman ps
```
